The Bay Area counties

Deep district maps of San Francisco, Oakland and the Bay Area: county outlines from the Census, streets and districts drawn by us.

Wildlife watch

No wildlife in view. Keep exploring near water and green space.

Sightings, photos, tags and badges here are play: kept on this device only, never a completion record, never money, never a permit or a licence. Sighting windows and seasons are an approximate, game calendar - not survey data, not season dates.

Season board
    Seasons & harvest

    Underwater depths, seabed and habitats (eelgrass, oyster reef, mudflat, riprap) are AUTHORED: no real bathymetry is held, so this is not a chart. Dive and ROV are a game camera for monitoring practice, not dive training. Animals are never harmed. Keys: R up, F down; ROV: I/K forward/back, J/L turn.

    Ground drawn from Census outline + AUTHORED fabric - not satellite, not a survey; carries no text

    • AUTHORED water - procedural creeks, channels and ponds, NOT the real creeks or reservoirs
    • AUTHORED cross-sections for the AUTHORED street polylines - generic, NOT a real street survey or standard
    • Physics is an arcade approximation: gravity 9.81 m/s^2; friction, restitution, mass, buoyancy, drag and damage are AUTHORED. Crashes are play - not a crash test, not safety or engineering advice. Vehicles never strike people, NPCs, pets or animals.
    • Animals, plants, litter and wind are AUTHORED ambience - generic species, not a wildlife survey; no animal is ever harmed.
    • Ground relief: USGS 3DEP (RECORDED), shown relative to local median land; water level AUTHORED. The median is of RECORDED land heights within 1.5 km of where you stood when the grid arrived (sampled every 100 m, then fixed); heights are ~150-185 m cell means (levees and street grades finer than a cell are not shown as measured), clamped to 0-12 m above the median (lower land is drawn at the median, never below its water plane) and flattened to street level near meshed streets, landmarks, stations and plots (AUTHORED); cells with no RECORDED height use AUTHORED knolls and levees (counted). Elevation: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP), 1 arc-second DEM; resampled by this bundle
    • Style families are AUTHORED game-scale recipes of generic detail components; a place name is general geography only; no replica of a real building; dimensions are not survey, code or standard values. Signs are play: AUTHORED names from word lists on AUTHORED economy game lots - never a real business, name or address. Patterns and colours: AUTHORED - drawn at runtime from parameters in surfaces/exterior.py; no photograph, supplier swatch, paint brand or standard colour value.
    • Space: jump when walking, brake when driving. Walk into AUTHORED water to wade or swim and climb out at any bank. Vehicles can crash into each other and into buildings - it is play, and no injury is depicted.

    W / S or the arrow keys move, A / D turn, Shift runs; drag to look. Walk or drive over a county border and the next county streams in. Boats stay on water.

    Fishing and crawfish

        • Every catch, trap haul and codex entry is PLAY: stored only on this device, never a completion record, never money, never a licence.
        • Real activity follows state rules - check the state wildlife agency (Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries; California Department of Fish and Wildlife) for licences, seasons, sizes and limits.
        • Seasons here are approximate, game calendar - not the legal seasons.
        • Species facts are general, from the kind of material state wildlife agencies publish in species profiles; game stats are AUTHORED on a 1-5 scale and are not sizes or records.
        • Never approach, feed or harass wildlife; alligators share Gulf waters and are dangerous - keep your distance.
        • Fishing spots sit on AUTHORED water (procedural lakes, bayous, canals, ponds and terrain) - not the real waters.

            What is real here

            • Flat AUTHORED ground at 0 m with water outside the land outline: no real elevation.
            • Buildings, trees and streets are AUTHORED procedural fabric, not the real street grid.
            • Satellite imagery is a view-time layer requested by your browser and never stored here.
            • Trees, plants and street details: AUTHORED placement of generally named regional plants and generic street furniture (rules by land use and distance to water) - not a tree survey, species map or count.
            • Vegetation placed on ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 land cover (RECORDED, ~90 m majority cells, CC BY 4.0); modified: majority class per 3 arc-second cell (9 x 9 source pixels), under-half-classified cells set to nodata, clipped to the parish and Bay registry bounds (landcover/fetch_landcover.py); species and exact positions AUTHORED; cells with no RECORDED class use the AUTHORED rules. © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
            • Generic vehicle and watercraft types only: no makes, models, brands or logos. Every dimension, mass, speed, acceleration, turning and seat figure is AUTHORED - a plausible arcade figure typed for a generic type, not measured and not the specification of any real machine. Driving here is play, not training: only the entries linked to an existing training seat open that seat, and no drive in the fleet enters a completion record.
            • Animals, plants, litter and wind are AUTHORED ambience - generic species, not a wildlife survey; no animal is ever harmed.
            • no real elevation: the Bay hills are not modelled; the ground is flat AUTHORED at 0 m
            • Ground drawn from Census outline + AUTHORED fabric - not satellite, not a survey; carries no text
            • no landmark is authored in the bayarea pack; pins are the geo registry campus points (as tagged) and RECORDED Locator.X city points only
            • RECORDED - US Census cartographic boundary via us-atlas 3.0.1 counties-10m (1:10m, coarse, coastline-clipped); vendored in parishes/vendor/us-atlas, sha-checked
            • Physics is an arcade approximation: gravity 9.81 m/s^2; friction, restitution, mass, buoyancy, drag and damage are AUTHORED. Crashes are play - not a crash test, not safety or engineering advice. Vehicles never strike people, NPCs, pets or animals.
            • AUTHORED cross-sections for the AUTHORED street polylines - generic, NOT a real street survey or standard
            • view-time only, in the learner's browser; never fetched, stored or baked by any build; the 4k maps contain no imagery
            • The Census cartographic outline is clipped to the COASTLINE: San Francisco Bay, San Pablo Bay and the Pacific lie OUTSIDE every land outline and are drawn as open water. Smaller inland water (reservoirs, sloughs, parts of the delta) is NOT cut out at 1:10m and lies inside outlines; area_km2 includes it.
            • AUTHORED water - procedural creeks, channels and ponds, NOT the real creeks or reservoirs

            Where the key goes, and what this is

            Model: reactor/lingbot-world-2. Where your key goes: an operator stores it as the Worker secret REACTOR_API_KEY (or in cloudflare/worker/.dev.vars for local wrangler dev) - never in this page.

            Reactor is not live until an operator deploys the Worker with the REACTOR_API_KEY secret.

            api.reactor.inc is unreachable from the environment that built this; the token route is tested only against a mocked fetch and no live session has been opened from here.

            The live view is play: it never enters a completion record and certifies nothing.

            The page never takes, stores or sees an API key; it asks this site's Worker for a short-lived token.
